Class Monitor

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.windowing.Monitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Monitor extends Object implements Cloneable
Data structure representing a monitor in the local graphics environment with a description, position, and dimensions

    • getIndex

      public int getIndex()
      Validate that this monitor is still available and get its index in the local graphics environment's array of screen devices. If this monitor's current index is unavailable this will revert the structure to representing the first index in the array of screen devices
      Returns:
      The current index of this monitor or 0

    • setIndex

      public boolean setIndex(int index)
      Set this monitor's index in the local graphics environment's array of screen devices. If the given index is unavailable, default to the first index in the array
      Parameters:
      index - The new monitor index for this monitor structure to represent
      Returns:
      Whether the given index was valid
